The merge is computed sequentially against the already-modified base: `tmp = b + 0.4*(f1 - b)` then `out = tmp + 0.4*(f2 - tmp)`, which expands to `0.36*b + 0.24*f1 + 0.4*f2` instead of the required `0.2*b + 0.4*f1 + 0.4*f2`. This violates "Required result" clause 2, which specifies `out[X] = base[X] + lambda*(ft1[X] - base[X]) + lambda*(ft2[X] - base[X])` with both task vectors taken against the unmodified base — precisely the ordering hazard the specification calls out. The resulting coefficient error (0.16 on base, 0.16 on ft1) is far beyond the 1e-3 relative Frobenius tolerance, so the 64 merged tensors will fail grading. The verification step, the merged-count check, and the 244-tensor output check are otherwise correct.
